measurements.recurrence_limit: This identifies attack repetition, not a uniquely identified musical tempo.
measurements.cap_limit: Up to180 strongest attack peaks retained per film; weak or masked UI sounds may be absent. Silence detection uses the full audio, independently of that cap.

palette: Keep app interactions tactile but restrained over warm chords and rounded bass. Coarse click/pop reports do not justify cash-register, loud game-win or one-sound-per-app effects. A newly composed gentle pad/pluck logo resolve fits the reported ending without copying its notes.
mix_guidance: Music should carry the rhythm. Treat every cue as optional; do not double the drum pattern with an SFX tick. For a first pass, use only key sends/selections/large transitions at low level, then verify against actual content-aware audio analysis. No reference audio samples may be used in the new soundtrack.

content_aware_evidence.reported_effects: Very short digital clicks/pops roughly near5,6,10,15and24s; the model itself says they are rhythmically integrated and difficult to distinguish from music percussion.
content_aware_evidence.ending_qualification: The model describes the main track fading around43s into a pad-and-gentle-notes logo resolve. This is semantic model evidence; no exact stem boundary or fade envelope was measured here.
content_aware_evidence.tempo_qualification: All caption BPM estimates remain approximate; the signal has beat/subdivision/half/double ambiguities. No exact tempo certification is added.
content_aware_evidence.timing_qualification: All preexisting numerical values, measured attacks, scores, cue durations, confidence values and source/output maps are preserved. Caption timestamps are approximate semantic context, not isolated effect alignment.
